# Project Governance 4.2.1

This patch repairs blocked pre-push preparation and preserves the evidence needed to recover a
proven stopped preparation run.

- Pre-push captures the exact pushed commit and remote comparison. Unrelated live or untracked
  archives no longer enter its committed context packet. Required inputs and capture limits remain enforced.
- Review hunks and candidate secret checks use the same committed input. Exhaustive live and staged
  secret checks remain active.
- Detached preparation failures retain their bounded cause and release only their own check reader.
- Recovery for the affected 4.2.0 generation requires its exact original identity and a verified
  stopped, oversized preparation. It preserves originals, unrelated readers and unknown outcome.

This is the stable publication of the implementation qualified in 4.2.1-rc.1. Source and independent
review evidence is retained where inputs are unchanged. The newly versioned archive receives fresh
offline installation, command, staging, greenfield, lint-backend and release-metadata qualification.
The source checkpoint passed 1,147 engine, 82 continuity and 100 proof-script cases, with 16 optional
browser cases skipped. Those source tests were not rerun solely to change the release version.

Native validation commands still execute in the live checkout. Committed packet capture does not
prove an isolated committed build. Hosted CI, physical devices, live provider compatibility,
accepted ordinary development outcomes and token/time savings remain outside this proof.

Adoption is deliberate. Publication does not update repository pins or retire live owners. The
separate startup replay, delayed-cleanup, packet-diagnostic and added-file capture repairs remain
pending review, integration and archive qualification.
